note: Rolling woods, fields and fishing ponds east of Kingston, crossed by gravel roads (County Road 345, Frog Pond Road, Allis Drive). Camping is at numbered primitive spots, each beside one of the area's small gravel parking lots, spread across about 4 km; one sits at the corner of a fishing pond just off Frog Pond Road. No facilities; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' - the map numbers 12 primitive camping spots, each at its own parking lot, spread over ~4 km of gravel roads (no distinct camping area, no split); free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin is on spot 94's small lot on Frog Pond Road. Pond lead for the neighbouring spot 93. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Individual Campsites'; the 04/13 map shows 12 numbered Primitive Camping Area symbols, each beside a parking lot, on CR 345, SE Frog Pond Road, SE Allis Drive, SE Wildlife Road and SE Crabapple Road. GIS layer 27 has the 12 points (93-104) and layer 26 the 12 matching lots (GIS says 'Paved'; the two viewed are white gravel). Spread: from 39.61989,-93.98868 (west, site near CR 345) to 39.61301,-93.92635 (east) - ~5 km end to end, every spot a single lot, so no distinct camping area to split off. Imagery at the pin: lot 2414 is a small gravel pad (~12 x 15 m) at the mouth of a gravel lane off Frog Pond Road (a 23-ft rig fits, tight to turn); lot 2413 at the lane's end is ~25 x 30 m. Gravel roads, no ford seen, no posted limit.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront) - lead for 'pond' at one spot: GIS camping point 93 (39.62176,-93.94723), 170 m from the pin at the end of the same lane, lies ~16 m from a fishing pond across open mowed grass (lot edge ~25-30 m). The pond measures ~100 x 165 m triangular on imagery, ~2 acres, under the 5-acre line, so 'pond' is the value if AWH wants the entry pinned there. The stored pin's spot (94) is ~200 m from the pond through woods - not waterfront. Lead only - stored value not changed.
PIN: stored 39.62063,-93.94585 = GIS camping point 94 on lot 2414 - on a camping spot, fine; central among the 12.
